description:
Reid Comfort 2 ST | Step-through commuter bike

Comfortable, accessible and built for everyday journeys – the ideal step-through commuter bike for getting around town, travelling along cycle paths and enjoying relaxed rides with less effort.

The Reid Bikes Comfort 2 ST is designed to make everyday cycling easy and enjoyable, combining a relaxed, upright riding position with a step-through frame for convenient mounting and dismounting. With its comfort-focused design and practical components, it's an ideal choice for commuting, trips into town and leisurely rides on local routes.

Its 27.5” double-wall alloy rims are paired with wide 2.35” all-terrain tyres to provide a stable, cushioned ride across a variety of surfaces. An 80mm travel suspension fork helps absorb bumps and vibrations, reducing the impact felt through the bike and making uneven roads and cycle paths more comfortable to ride.

A Shimano Tourney 21-speed drivetrain with Revoshift shifters provides a versatile range of gears for tackling flat roads, hills and varied terrain. Lightweight alloy V-brakes deliver controlled stopping power, while ergonomic handlebars, comfortable grips and a supportive comfort saddle help create a relaxed riding position for everyday journeys and longer rides.

The step-through frame makes getting on and off the bike easier, particularly when stopping frequently or riding in everyday clothing. Combined with its upright geometry and comfort-focused components, the Comfort 2 ST offers a practical, accessible option for commuters who prioritise comfort and convenience.

With its versatile setup, easy-access frame and excellent value, the Reid Bikes Comfort 2 ST makes everyday cycling more enjoyable. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands or exploring your local area, it's built to help you get out and ride in comfort.

The Reid Bikes Comfort 2 ST is ideal for:

Everyday commuters, looking for a comfortable and accessible way to get around town

Riders who value easy access, with a step-through frame that makes mounting and dismounting more convenient

Comfort-focused cyclists, with an upright riding position, ergonomic handlebars, comfortable grips and a supportive saddle

Riders tackling hills and varied routes, with Shimano Tourney 21-speed gearing for a versatile range of riding options

Cycling across different surfaces, with 2.35” all-terrain tyres and 27.5” double-wall alloy rims for a stable, cushioned ride

Smoother everyday journeys, with an 80mm suspension fork to help absorb bumps and vibrations

Confident everyday stopping, with lightweight alloy V-brakes for controlled braking

Commuters seeking practicality and value, with a comfortable, versatile design for work, shopping and everyday trips

Anyone looking for an alternative to driving, making everyday journeys more active, comfortable and enjoyable

27.5 Uding D6 fork 80mm travel with lockout
